# YouTube Migration · Verified Stage

The Awtsmoos preserves this verified staging copy as deployment evidence while Awtsmoos.com keeps current behavior grounded in the live YouTube migration source.

The staged contract covers Google Takeout archives, owned-video downloads, advanced creator-owned `yt-dlp` workflows, playlist-to-Series provenance, chronology preservation, captions/transcripts, optional Archive.org workflows, dry planning, idempotent unified-social publication, and resumable checkpoints.

For current runtime behavior use `geelooy/youtube/DOCUMENTATION.md`, `/youtube/`, and `/youtube/migrate/`. This directory is transfer evidence, not the live authority.
